prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 74.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Choice Flow: Introduce a interactive personality card selection sub-flow inside pet adoption to build emotional attachment before creation. (why: Adoption has high drop-off (32.1%) and users spend over 16 minutes in this phase, needing clearer structured steps.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Auth Flow: Reorder the onboarding sequence to place account sign-in right after pet creation and adoption certificate step. (why: Sign-in drops 25.3% of users early before they have chosen or customized their pet.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Quick Path Selection Tip Carousel: Display an automatic tip carousel explaining path options after 5 seconds of idle time on the choose path screen. (why: Users take an average of 514s on choose_path, indicating indecision between pathways.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Desktop Spawning Status Feed: Enable live setup step progress and notification controls on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: Home waiting screen takes a mean of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to show up on desktop.)
4: [finish, layout] First Desktop Interaction Welcome Banner: Switch home intro screen to spotlight layout with prominent mascot avatar and immediate action button. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and overall onboarding completion is only 21.5%.)

scores.note: Adoption step loses 32.1% of users with long duration; new sub-flow requires building new screens.
Sign-in drops 25.3% early; reordering flow requires non-trivial navigation updates.
Choose path drop-off is lower (19.6%) but mean time is high (514s); tip carousel is low cost.
Supported by both funnel (2336s mean wait) and direct support tickets reporting missing desktop pets.
Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%); updating intro layout requires moderate UI refactoring.
